limits: Prospective descriptive single-model spending pilot; labels are dataset labels, not model errors. Final prompt state is the estimand; YES/NO compliance is descriptive. The best comparator is an upward-selected estimate. Intervals are conditional on the frozen folds and pointwise, without simultaneous depth coverage. n=200 cannot establish a reliable three-point advantage. ANLI's one pair per fold has no pair bootstrap variability. The permutation null assumes conditional exchangeability within pairs. No pooling, cross-model, placement-law, or conditional incremental claim. sink_draw is a new, unregistered descriptive diagnostic outside the comparator set and the spending rule.
